========================================================================
IMPORTANT NOTES FOR SAFEGENOME PROJECT
========================================================================

1. ASSAY UNCERTAINTY: The K562 dataset assay type is unconfirmed. The DeepCRISPR
   paper aggregated data from multiple assays. Must verify ref [44] in Zhu 2018
   to determine if K562 data is from a cell-based or cell-free assay.

2. NO NEGATIVES: The dataset contains ONLY detected off-target sites (positives).
   For SafeGenome model training, you need negative sites (Cas-OFFinder candidates
   that were NOT detected). These negatives are NOT in this file.

3. REGRESSION VS BINARY: The Cleavage Frequency allows regression modeling,
   but for binary classification you would threshold (e.g., CF > 0.01 = positive).

4. K562 + ALPHAGENOME ADVANTAGE: If the K562 assay is cell-based and valid,
   this dataset is uniquely valuable: K562 is the only cell type with full
   DNase + ATAC + histone tracks in AlphaGenome. All 12 sgRNAs would have
   complete chromatin feature extraction possible.
